name: apprenti.dev Platform / DevOps Engineering Apprenticeship
audience: Software engineers or ops engineers moving into platform/DevOps specialization, with solid coding ability but not necessarily prior infrastructure experience
philosophy: Evidence-driven apprenticeship: build a real pipeline, ship through it, observe what happens, and be able to roll it back.
aiPrinciples: AI assistance must be disclosed when materially used.
Tasks may restrict solution generation while allowing explanations, hints and quizzes.
The apprentice remains accountable for every pipeline, infrastructure change and rollback they submit.
Mentor approval is based on demonstrated understanding and live failure-injection response, not passing automation alone.
